caption:

When your gut microbiome is out of balance → estrogen metabolism is disrupted → you get hormonal symptoms.

Supporting your gut health directly supports hormonal health.

title: Build Habits That Actually Last
caption:
Why most wellness habits don't last — and the fix 🌹

The problem: we try to start too many habits at once and quit when life gets hard.

The solution: habit stacking + identity anchoring.

HABIT STACKING:
Attach new habits to existing ones.
→ After I pour my morning coffee, I write 3 gratitudes.
→ Before I get into bed, I review my next day's intention.

IDENTITY ANCHORING:
Frame habits as who you ARE, not what you DO.
→ Not "I'm trying to drink more water" → "I'm someone who prioritizes hydration."
→ Not "I should exercise more" → "I'm a woman who moves her body."

Your identity drives your behavior. Change the story, change the habit.

Save this. Start one tonight. 🌹
